subject: Draft Tree Ordinance Review
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to review draft tree ordinance 19-070 and comments from legal counsel and department heads. The committee approved motions directing legal counsel to split and format the draft into existing city code sections and requesting staffing and financial assessments while keeping the matter in committee.

items.title: Discussion on Draft Tree Ordinance
items.summary: The committee discussed legal and administrative feedback on draft tree ordinance 19-070, focusing on public shade tree laws, private property regulations, low-income housing exemptions, DPW staffing requirements, and tree fund provisions.

items.title: Committee Motions and Referral
items.summary: The committee approved consolidated motions directing legal counsel to restructure the ordinance, requesting staffing estimates from department heads, and seeking financial guidance on the tree fund, while keeping the paper in committee.
